title: Leave a group
summary: A confirm sheet before the user leaves a group. It warns when the user is the only person left or the only admin.

warning.description: alone: RoomInfo.joinedMembersCount is 1 (bipe_app_group_leave_alone). lastAdmin: the user is the only joined admin and other people are in the group (bipe_app_group_leave_last_admin). none: bipe_app_group_leave_body.

phase.description: confirm: the sheet. leaving: bipe_app_group_leaving. failed: bipe_app_group_leave_error, the buttons come back.

appear.effect: Reads RoomInfo and the members' roles to set warning.

chooseAdmin.effect: lastAdmin only: closes the sheet and opens group-members, where the user makes someone admin.

leave.effect: Room.leave. On success closes the chat and goes back to the chat list; the group leaves the list.

notes: Groups only. A DM never leaves: its menu has dm-delete instead (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#464).
lastAdmin: the user can still leave. The sheet shows bipe_app_group_leave_choose_admin first and bipe_app_group_leave_confirm second. The user decides.
The leave button uses the destructive style.
Room.forget is not called. A left group can come back through a new invite.
